about.title: About Me
about.intro: I'm a developer passionate about technology and continuous learning.
about.experience_text: My experience covers the development of full-stack web applications, using frameworks like Vue.js on the frontend and Node.js with Sequelize on the backend. I have designed and consumed REST APIs and have knowledge of microservices architecture. Additionally, I have developed video games with Unity, exploring multiplayer creation with Mirror and integration with Steamworks. My focus is on writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
about.interests_text: I am an enthusiast of continuous learning, always exploring new technological frontiers. I am deeply interested in deployment automation (CI/CD) with tools like GitHub Actions and application containerization with Docker. I am passionate about both creating interactive user interfaces and building robust server logic, always seeking the best tool for each challenge.

projects.title: My Projects
projects.subtitle: Here are some of the projects I've worked on
projects.synapse_desc: Collaborative agenda with several calendar types (work, education, personal and shared), roles and approval workflows, plus real-time notifications. Personal project in development: use test data only. The first load can take up to a minute.
projects.optica_desc: Website for an optician in Zaragoza, with a minimalist design, interactive animations, appointment requests and an email contact form.
projects.typing_desc: Typing game made with Vue, Node.js using router, Pinia, Sockets, Sequelize, Docker, GitHub Actions, SQL, and Mongo, plus Nginx for reverse proxy. It's a DAW class project.
